summary: The return prints close to the official sheet on all three pages: combs line up, Schedule 1 fills every fixed row, totals land in the right boxes. Remaining faults are an overflowing Others description, 'Others' rows that always print 0.00 tax due, and a contact/email row that only fills at view time.

defects.what: A long Others description runs out of its cell into the Tax Bracket column and is clipped at the column edge ('...TEXT FOR OVERFLOW|7654321.09'); the bracket value it collides with is unreadable. The text is neither wrapped nor shortened.

defects.where: Page 3, Schedule 1 'Others (specify)' rows, Basic Excise Tax Due column
defects.what: Every Others row prints 0.00 tax due even with millions of taxable base and a rate entered. There is no Tax Due input for these rows, and whatever the writer emits stays 0.00, so an excise return on an unlisted product reports no tax.
The Applicable Tax Rate cell prints the raw typed text ('6543210.98') with no percent sign and no validation, while the fixed rows above print real rates like 22% or 43.00.

defects.where: Item 19, 'Less: Payment on Returns Previously Filed'
defects.what: Prints a lone '0' in the amount comb for an unamended return where the official sheet would be left blank; harmless but unlike the surrounding unfilled boxes which stay empty.

Items 8 Contact Number and 9 Email Address only appear because the preview window fills them at view time; the sheet.html the preview window writes to disk keeps those comb cells empty until the webview injects them (verified: the file on disk contains neither value while the window and the saved PDF show both). Output is correct, but the written file alone is not a faithful record.

entered_by_hand: Clicked Part II '13 Payment on Actual Removal' on the real form page; opened Part V Schedule 1 row 1 (XA035, Effective January 1, 2020) and retyped Tax Base Taxable as 5,555,555.55 — the Basic Excise Tax Due recomputed to 1,111,111.11 on screen and prints that value on page 2.
open_questions: The official reference is the byte-frozen official sheet (html-frozen/2200a-2020/index.html) rendered to PDF, not the named source PDF, which is not mirrored in buwiz-forms-html.

Basic Excise Tax Due for 'Others (specify)' rows may need a designated rate the demo payload did not supply in the format the writer expects; the 0.00 could be a fill-format issue rather than a writer bug, but no input format is documented or enforced on screen.
checked_by_hand: Re-opened the saved draft after patching the taxpayer phone/email, re-verified validation in-app, opened the preview a second time and compared the saved PDF page images against the official render before writing this report. The blank Items 8/9 seen on the first preview were stale draft state from the fill, not a print defect.
